text:
## Subject Access Request (SAR) Process  
**Customer Right:** Obtain copy of personal data  
**Process:**  
1. **Request Submission**
- Email: privacy@firstuk.bank
- Phone: 0800-555-2265
- In person: Any branch  
2. **Verification**
- FirstUK Bank verifies customer identity
- May request additional identification
- Security check (fraud prevention)  
3. **Compilation**
- Collect data from all systems
- Remove third-party personal data (may redact)
- Compile in accessible format  
4. **Response**
- Data provided within 30 days
- Format: Electronic (CSV, PDF, etc.)
- May extend 2 months for complex requests  
5. **Redactions**
- Legal professional privilege redacted
- Third-party confidential data redacted
- Trade secrets redacted

raw_entities.name: Subject Access Request Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the process by which customers may request and obtain copies of their personal data held by FirstUK Bank. Establishes submission channels, verification procedures, compilation requirements, response timelines, and permissible redactions.
context: Customer Right: Obtain copy of personal data

raw_entities.name: SAR Request Submission via Multiple Channels
raw_entities.description: Customers may submit Subject Access Requests through three designated channels: email to privacy@firstuk.bank, telephone to 0800-555-2265, or in person at any branch.

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification for SAR
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank must verify customer identity upon SAR submission, may request additional identification documents, and must conduct a security check for fraud prevention purposes.

raw_entities.name: SAR Data Compilation from All Systems
raw_entities.description: The bank must collect personal data from all systems, remove or redact third-party personal data, and compile the information in an accessible format for delivery to the customer.

raw_entities.name: SAR Response Timeframe
raw_entities.description: Personal data must be provided to the customer within 30 days of request submission. The bank may extend this deadline by up to 2 months for complex requests.
context: May extend 2 months for complex requests

raw_entities.name: SAR Response Format
raw_entities.description: Personal data provided in response to a SAR must be delivered in electronic format, with acceptable formats including CSV, PDF, and other standard electronic file types.

raw_entities.name: Permissible Redactions in SAR Response
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank may redact or withhold certain categories of information from SAR responses: data subject to legal professional privilege, third-party confidential data, and trade secrets.

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Bank
raw_entities.description: The bank responsible for implementing and executing the Subject Access Request process, including identity verification, data compilation, response delivery, and permissible redactions.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: A natural person holding a banking relationship with FirstUK Bank who has the right to submit a Subject Access Request to obtain a copy of their personal data.
context: Customer Right: Obtain copy of personal data

raw_entities.name: Subject Access Request
raw_entities.description: A formal request submitted by a customer to FirstUK Bank to obtain a copy of their personal data. The bank must respond within 30 days (extendable to 2 months for complex requests) with data compiled from all systems, subject to permissible redactions.
context: Customer Right: Obtain copy of personal data

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification Control
raw_entities.description: A security control requiring verification of customer identity and potential request for additional identification documents before processing a Subject Access Request, with fraud prevention checks integrated.
